summary: iter382 CLS regression fix VERIFIED PARTIALLY. LazyMount implementation is CORRECT (minHeight kept forever after mount, `contain: layout style paint` computed as `content`, per-section minHeight applied 520-1000px, lazy chunk loading preserved — HomepageVehicleCarousel + ProfessionalAuctionsPromo chunks only download after scroll). HOWEVER the goal `CLS < 0.1` is NOT MET. Measured CLS = 0.8628 on mobile 390x780 with full-page scroll journey via PerformanceObserver({type:'layout-shift',buffered:true}). The CLS shifts are NOT caused by the LazyMount sections — they come from the HERO section which is above-the-fold and unrelated to iter382 scope.

ui_bugs.issue: Continuous CLS shifts (sum ~0.63) from ~24 `DIV.absolute w-1 h-1 bg-cyan-400 rounded-full opacity-60` particles repositioning via top/left inline styles instead of CSS transform. Every reposition triggers layout-shift entry. Occurs 300-2000ms after paint and continues during scroll. Uses top/left not transform:translate — every frame is a real layout shift.

Large CLS shift (0.5476 single-entry) from `DIV.absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[600px] h-[600px]` — its rendered rect changed from y=290 h=489 to y=311 h=468 at t=1601ms. Blob is centered via translate-x/y-1/2 but appears to reflow as hero container resizes when late content settles. Move it out of layout with `contain` or wrap in a fixed-size positioned parent.

Shift 0.2256 at t=1186ms — footer previousRect was {y:604, h:176} then currentRect became {0,0,0,0} (detached/re-mounted). Footer was momentarily rendered high on the page then pushed down when children below Suspense boundary mounted. This means one of the Suspense fallbacks (SectionSkeleton for HomepageVehicleCarousel / ProfessionalAuctionsPromo) may not be reserving enough height, OR the footer briefly rendered before LazyMount refs / minHeights took effect on first paint. Verify SectionSkeleton heights match the real component heights AND that the LazyMount wrappers reserve space on the very first paint (SSR/first-render), not only after useEffect.

action_items: PRIMARY: Fix hero cyan-400 particle dots to use CSS `transform: translate3d()` instead of top/left inline positioning. Add `will-change: transform` and `contain: strict` on the particle container. This alone should drop CLS by ~0.63.

SECONDARY: Wrap the hero 600x600 decorative blob container with `contain: layout paint` or convert its position anchoring to pure transform (no width/height reflow) so it can't push siblings when the hero grows.

TERTIARY: Ensure Suspense fallback (SectionSkeleton) for HomepageVehicleCarousel + ProfessionalAuctionsPromo reserves the SAME height as the LazyMount `minHeight` prop that wraps them — check for mismatch that causes the ~0.22 footer shift when the lazy chunk resolves.
Consider adding `contain: layout paint` on the top-level hero section wrapper too — the LazyMount `contain: content` only helps below-the-fold sections; the hero itself has no containment.
critical_code_review_comments: LazyMount iter382 impl (HomePage.js line 52-85) is correctly written: minHeight stays applied when visible=true, `contain: layout style paint` (browser normalized to `content`) is set, and IntersectionObserver disconnects after first hit. GOOD.
Per-section minHeight tuning is present and appropriate (900/520/900/720/1000/900/900/900/700/800 px). GOOD.

However the CLS regression scope was misdiagnosed — the actual CLS is dominated by hero-internal animated particles + a large decorative blob, NOT by LazyMount section swaps. Fixing LazyMount alone cannot bring CLS < 0.1 because the hero contributes >0.6 by itself.
Recommend using `transform` for ANY position-animated decorative element to avoid layout shifts.

rca of the issue: Root Cause: iter382 fixed the WRONG source of CLS. The LazyMount changes are correct and prevent LazyMount-related shifts, but the dominant CLS on this homepage comes from the HERO section (which is not lazy-mounted, is above the fold, and was not touched by iter382). Two specific hero sub-components cause it: (1) ~20-30 animated cyan particle dots (`div.absolute.w-1.h-1.bg-cyan-400.rounded-full`) that reposition using top/left inline styles rather than CSS transform — every frame their new position triggers a layout-shift entry (~0.001-0.002 each, and they cluster into large shifts of 0.63 when many move at once); (2) a `div.absolute.w-[600px].h-[600px]` centered decorative blob that gets clipped/resized when the hero container reflows (rect changed from y=290 h=489 to y=311 h=468 at 1601ms → single 0.5476 shift). Reproduction: load page at 390x780, observe layout-shift entries via PerformanceObserver — shifts start at ~1100ms and continue through the particle animation cycle. Mitigation: switch animated particles to `transform: translate3d(x,y,0)` (transforms don't cause layout shift), wrap decorative blob with `contain: layout paint` and ensure its size is not affected by parent reflow, and audit Suspense fallback heights to match real component heights for HomepageVehicleCarousel + ProfessionalAuctionsPromo lazy loads.
